'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a community goal [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{Quote|It's not in my nature to be asking on behalf of others, but an acquaintance of mine desperately needs your help! She has a patient who is in critical condition and needs to be treated urgently. This person is extremely important to some... influential people. She has the medications she needs, but needs bandaging supplies. I would be very grateful if you could help!}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over [[Aseptic bandage]]s
* Hand over [[Army bandage]]s

==Rewards==
*1× [[Medicine case]]
*4× [[Grizzly medical kit]]
*2× [[Vaseline balm]]
*5× [[Propital regenerative stimulant injector]]
*3× [[eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector]]
*+5 [[Surgery|Surgery skill]] levels
*+5 [[Health|Health skill]] levels
{{Quote|Thank you, mercenary! Let's hope the patient recovers. The surgery was successful, and now it's all in his hands to recover safely.}}

In this quest you have to hand over as many bandages of each type as you can or want, till the community goal of 10.000.000 bandages is reached.

==Trivia==
*This quest was released together with the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrSN4OpCSsk Chronicles of Ryzhy <nowiki>[S2]</nowiki> Chpt. 1 short film], in which the character "Ryzhy" gets wounded. He is the "important patient" that is referred to in the dialogue.
*This is the first community goal quest that was added to the game.
*The initial goal was 1,000,000 bandages before it got changed to 10,000,000 shortly after the quest appearance
*The goal was reached after 8 days on April 15, 2023 and lead to the release of the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YWfYmOf7NGQ Chronicles of Ryzhy <nowiki>[S2]</nowiki> Chpt. 2 short film]
